'''Doogo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[slythmonger/Legends|slythmonger]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], [[Hal Horn]] tasked a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] with meeting with him on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].
